title: The Road of Yellow Brick
description: From a grey Kansas farm to an emerald city: four unlikely companions, each certain they are missing something. Adapted from the 1900 book.

rights.notes: Baum died in 1919; the book was published in 1900. Public domain in India and the US. Book only: nothing from the 1939 film (for example, the shoes are silver in the book, not ruby).
